description: This file defines a class PagerDutyAlerting, which extends SlackAlerting, to provide alerting functionality for high failure rates and hanging requests in an LLM API system. It integrates with PagerDuty to send critical alerts based on configured thresholds, tracks failure and hanging events, and contains methods for logging events, checking thresholds, and sending alerts.

classes.name: PagerDutyAlerting
classes.description: A class for alerting via PagerDuty for high failure rates and hanging requests. Extends SlackAlerting and implements logic to track failure/hang events, threshold checks, and alert notifications.

methods.name: __init__( self, alerting_args: Optional[Union[AlertingConfig, dict]] = None, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the PagerDutyAlerting instance, setting API key and alert thresholds, and creating internal event tracking lists.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Records a failure event and checks whether to trigger an alert based on failure thresholds within a time window.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook to initiate hanging request detection by scheduling a handler.

methods.name: hanging_response_handler( self, request_data: Optional[dict], user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth )
methods.description: Checks if a request has hung by waiting for the threshold duration and then assessing if the request completed; records hanging events if necessary.

methods.name: _send_alert_if_thresholds_crossed( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], window_seconds: int, threshold: int, alert_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Checks if the number of recent events exceeds the threshold in the given window and, if so, sends an alert to PagerDuty.

methods.name: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent] _build_error_summaries( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], max_errors: int = 5 )
methods.description: Creates brief summaries of recent error events for alert details.

methods.name: send_alert_to_pagerduty(self, alert_message: str, custom_details: dict)
methods.description: Sends a formatted alert message with details to PagerDuty asynchronously.
